claims: The Runs view renders the real aggregate DeepEval result as 181 passed and 5 failed across 186 checks, without inventing a model matrix.
The Evals view renders all 27 registered Flex evaluator definitions and identifies the 26 exercised by the latest run.
The restored Chorus UI reads the real local Flex OTLP trace and exposes monitor and OTLP source views.
isolation: Local Chorus server reading the isolated local Robofit .chorus OTLP and evaluation sidecars; no production services, customer messages, or mutable production data.
limitations: The local store contains one Flex trace, so production-volume latency and cost trends remain sparse; the imported DeepEval run is complete.
